lines: Forgot your password? Now there is a way back in.
Under the password field on Sign in, Forgot your password opens a short form, on phone and desktop.
Enter the email you joined with and press send. The button says, sending, then the screen tells you to check your email.
Whether we know that email or not, the answer is exactly the same, so nobody can use this form to find out who is a member.
A member gets one email with a link that lasts thirty minutes. We keep only a fingerprint of it, never the link itself.
An email that isn't complete is named on the field before anything is sent.
If the server fails, a message says so, and your email stays, ready to try again.
And one account gets at most three links an hour, so no inbox can be flooded.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice twenty point two: choose a new password.
That's slice twenty point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
